evaluate_predictions_against_targets: run the Evaluator evaluate method to compute metrics like ROUGE, BLEU, and BERT score on predictions versus reference targets
format_evaluation_inputs: format and normalize input texts, predictions, and reference targets into tokenized lists for evaluation
get_scorers_for_metrics: get a list of scorer objects for specified metrics including HuggingFace and custom metrics
evaluate_metric_by_scorer: evaluate a single metric scorer against candidate and reference tokens or texts with category grouping
remove_wikipedia_markup: clean Wikipedia-specific syntax from text by removing wikilinks, categories, sections, and other markup
